Before you line up

The useful details.

Race-day information, all in one place.

Saturday 17 April 2027, starting on Henry Street in the heart of Kenmare — the same start location as the Ring of Beara Cycle. The provisional Half Marathon start is 8am. Final start times for all distances and finish details will be confirmed.

Entries open on 20 November 2026 at 9am. Registration is through Njuko and the entry link will be published here. Early-bird entry saves €5 until 30 November 2026.

Half Marathon €55 early bird (€60 from 1 December). 10K €30 early bird (€35 from 1 December). 5K €20 early bird (€25 from 1 December).

Chip timing, a finisher's medal and a premium-designed event T-shirt, plus free parking, bag drop, toilets on route, and water and fuel stations. There is post-race entertainment and prizes across all age categories.

Route details for all three distances will be published here ahead of the event.

Age limits and cut-off times will be confirmed with the final race details.

Race number arrangements will be confirmed ahead of the event and emailed to entrants.

Parking is free, and there is a bag drop and toilets on route. Final parking locations will be confirmed with the race-day details.

Entry transfer details will be confirmed when entries open.

Email info@redlineevents.ie and the team will come back to you.
